capabilities: Create spoilers by wrapping text in || or via a command
Reveal or hide spoilers by clicking them
Keep all spoilers visible via an Always show spoilers setting
Style spoilers with CSS variables and classes
extras: The README states the author is no longer an active Obsidian user, so fixes and features come from community pull requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in syntax for hiding inline spoiler text that readers must click to reveal.
summary: Discord-style inline spoiler plugin that hides text wrapped in || syntax until clicked in the editor.
